title: 19-inch rack panel
description: A 19-inch rack front panel (EIA-310-D / IEC 60297) of 1 to 4 U, cut and bent from aluminium or steel sheet: flat, or with stiffening flanges bent back between the rails; M6 mounting slots or holes on the rail pattern, handle holes, and a row of D-sub or XLR (Neutrik D) cut-outs or a window. It bolts onto any 19-inch rack, and onto the rails of the rack-cabinet Jig, whose sides it fits between. Flat: export the face set Cut sheet (DXF or SVG). Flanged: the flat pattern with its bend lines is written by file.export with sheetMetal (see the README).
